necessary_context.content: Minimize Ψ=f+h over nonempty compact convex X⊂R^n with a general norm and its dual. f is convex with ||∇f(x)−∇f(y)||_*≤L||x−y||; h is convex and M-Lipschitz. For each x, the Borel stochastic Oracle returns G(x,ξ) with E G(x,ξ)=g(x)∈∂Ψ(x) and E||G(x,ξ)−g(x)||_*²≤σ². Draws are iid and fresh relative to the current query history.
necessary_context.name: SCO and A1

necessary_context.content: At relative-interior points, subgradients lie in lin(X−X). At boundary points, ∂φ(x) consists of limits of relative-interior subgradients along convergent point/subgradient sequences; outside X it is empty. This is the paper's convention, rather than adding arbitrary domain normal vectors.
necessary_context.name: Subgradient convention

necessary_context.content: ω is convex and continuous on X. X°={x∈X: x∈argmin_{u∈X}[〈p,u〉+ω(u)] for some p∈R^n} is convex; on X°, ω is continuously differentiable and satisfies 〈∇ω(x′)−∇ω(x),x′−x〉≥α||x′−x||², α>0. V(x,z)=ω(z)−ω(x)−〈∇ω(x),z−x〉 and P_x(y)=argmin_{z∈X}{〈y,z−x〉+V(x,z)}∈X°. D_{ω,X}²=max_Xω−min_Xω. For x1∈argmin_Xω, V(x1,x)≤D_{ω,X}² for every x∈X.
